questions.q: Does Ari's play count as your look, so the Between's next round may start?
questions.why_you: hx-looks-gate names your look, and the Between has three builds you have not ticked (#366, #367, the lanterns #380). The record holds no ruling on whether the other player's play counts. Your answer decides whether a build thread starts now or waits for you.
questions.not_before: Ari had not played until your message of 2026-10-21.

options.label: A. Yes, Ari's play counts (recommended)
options.c: Round 4 starts now: captions at reading speed, moving your own items, spirits that move naturally. Your own look is owed before round 5. Shaman, Architect and Diplomat back this.

options.label: B. No, I look first
options.c: Round 4 waits until you tick the hollow and lantern steps on your phone. The formation card still goes to Ari now. Regent and Challenger back this.
